description: A shell script for testing git fast-import of notes objects, including creating commits, notes, and testing various operations like add, update, delete, and fanout handling in git notes.

methods.name: fast_import_commits
methods.description: Creates a specified number of commits in a given ref, appending commands to a file.

methods.name: fast_import_notes
methods.description: Creates a specified number of notes for commits in a given notes ref, appending commands to a file.
